objective: Test whether same-venue Bybit USDC-settled BTC/ETH perpetual trade innovations causally predict an after-cost directional response in the USDT-settled perpetuals before any official 2024 opening.

excluded: quarter-hour, OCO, auction, VWAP, round-number, positioning, options and fixed-portfolio scopes

used_pre_cutoff_videos.title: The Beginner's Guide to Making Money with Crypto Arbitrage
used_pre_cutoff_videos.role: segmented markets can display temporary price discrepancies, but fees and execution determine economic value

used_pre_cutoff_videos.title: What Is Basis and Arbitrage Yield Trading?
used_pre_cutoff_videos.role: participant preferences can create basis; simultaneous execution and convergence risk are essential

source_concept_contract.interpretation: The videos motivate a falsifiable segmentation hypothesis only; they are not evidence of profitability and their cross-exchange or delta-neutral tactics are not copied.

data_contract.discovery_role: data feasibility, candidate construction and fit thresholds only; never reported as frozen validation
data_contract.frozen_validation_date_selection_rule: UTC calendar day 15 of every still-unopened full month July, August, October and November 2023
data_contract.integrity: record downloaded byte count, decompressed row count and SHA-256 of the retrieved payload for every archive

discovery_observations_not_validation_re.frozen_validation_motivation: USDC activity is sparse and observed gross effects were below 12 bp; only a frozen unseen exception can justify expansion.

causal_event_contract.usdc_event: all USDC perpetual fills sharing the exact exchange timestamp, completed before any decision
causal_event_contract.event_price: last observed USDC trade price in stable archive order at that timestamp
causal_event_contract.event_notional: sum(size * price) across the completed timestamp group
causal_event_contract.event_imbalance: sum(aggressor_sign * size * price) divided by total event notional
causal_event_contract.usdc_move_bps: 10000 * log(current USDC event price / previous USDC event price)
causal_event_contract.usdt_pre_move_bps: 10000 * log(last USDT trade price at current event time / last USDT trade price at previous USDC event time)
causal_event_contract.entry_mark: first USDT trade at or after current USDC event timestamp plus 100 ms
causal_event_contract.exit_mark: first USDT trade at or after entry timestamp plus the frozen diagnostic horizon
causal_event_contract.missing_mark: event is ineligible; no favorable carry-forward or deletion after acceptance
causal_event_contract.same_timestamp_cross_symbol_tie_break: BTC before ETH after deterministic sort
causal_event_contract.global_slot_release: at the selected exit-mark timestamp for that candidate

frozen_hypothesis_families.mechanism: a large USDC move not yet incorporated by USDT reveals a segmented-pool lead
the USDC innovation after removing completed USDT movement continues into USDT
a USDC-specific stale or liquidity shock is rejected rather than transmitted
aggressive USDC participant control leads the more liquid USDT contract

frozen_candidate_grid.threshold_learning: all symbol-specific signal and notional quantiles use only the three disclosed discovery dates

cost_and_path_contract.funding: not separately modeled because the longest markout is 300 seconds and funding/settlement clocks are excluded
cost_and_path_contract.qualification: fatal diagnostic only; any survivor still requires structural entries/exits, exact BBO/depth, risk sizing, funding and account NAV replay

frozen_validation_gate.positive_symbol_date_fraction_at_18bp: >= 2/3 of the eight frozen symbol-date segments

conditional_decision.if_zero_survivors: close this exact USDC-event-to-USDT formulation without opening 2024 or adding execution/risk detail
conditional_decision.if_survivor_exists: reconstruct broader 2023 coverage and freeze one family before any official 2024 opening; do not select on 2024
